lines.zh: 我在水里游，背鳍露出水面。
lines.en: I swim with my dorsal fin above the surface.
My tail drives me forward.
Water streams past my gills.
I glide without a ripple.
I make a wide circle around you.
I skim the riverbed.
I rise to the surface and sink again.
My shadow follows on the bottom.

lines.zh: 我往脚能踩到底的地方游。
lines.en: I swim toward where feet can reach the bottom.
I never cover my teeth with lips.

lines.zh: 我兜了一大圈回到原处。
lines.en: I loop far around and come back.
I never stop swimming.
I come too near the bank.
I turn and my fin cuts the water.
I swim at your boat.
I dive and vanish.
I hang in the water, steady.
Only my fin tip shows above the surface.
Something is thrashing below the surface.
One sweep of my tail carries me forward.
I let the water run between my teeth.

lines.zh: 那股味道从上游漂下来。
lines.en: The scent drifts down from upstream.
I wait for it to thicken.
I sink an inch at a time into the dark.

lines.zh: 我这一双眼睛从不合上。
lines.en: These two eyes of mine never close.
No ripple on the surface.
I rise again.
I keep hidden beneath this stretch of water.
My gill slits open and close, filtering the current.
Weeds brush my flank.
I look at you from under the water.
Only one bank stands between us.

lines.zh: 你的脚尖离水只有一指。
lines.en: Your toes are a finger's width from the water.
My eyes are all black.
Look down and you will see me.
I circle once and return.
I hang in the dark water, watching you.
Your reflection lies above me.
My lower jaw slowly drops loose.
It is very quiet in the water.
I roll over once.
Blood trails out behind me.
I spin once.
My fin tilts.
I shake the blood and mud from my jaws.
I dive again.
One of my teeth is gone.
It did not even scuff my scales.
I fix on your legs from below.
I will be back.

lines.zh: 那种东西不配进我的嘴。
lines.en: That does not belong in my mouth.
Give me meat.
That hint of blood carries a long way.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西已经落水。
lines.en: What you held has already hit the water.
I watch it sink to the riverbed.
Not enough.
I suck it down along with the water.
A taste spreads through the water.
I want more.
That would not fill a tooth.
I knock you aside.
My hide is rough.
The surface bursts.
You slip at the water's edge.
I dive again.

lines.zh: 这一身皮肉撞得你发晕。
lines.en: My bulk leaves your head ringing.
My fin sweeps your leg.
Silt swirls up.
I retreat to deeper water.
You have not found your footing.
There are other sharks in the water.
We circle the same coral.
First we face off in the water.
A faint scent is in the water.

lines.zh: 她的侧鳍擦过我的侧鳍。
lines.en: Her fin brushes against mine.
Afterward we swim our separate ways.
Two fin trails remain on the surface.
I swim back into the deep.
This water is wide enough.
I am enough on my own.
My teeth clamp down on it at once.
My teeth hit stone.

lines.zh: 我把它吐出来又咬回去。
lines.en: I spit it out and bite it again.
It sinks fast.
I balance it on my snout.

lines.zh: 这种破烂不值得我张嘴。
lines.en: Such junk is not worth opening my mouth for.
I swim with it.
It slips between my teeth.
I catch it again.
This whole riverbed belongs to me.
Your boots are already soaked through.
I swim at you.
My fin cuts the surface.
That taste in the water thickens.
My teeth slide out from behind my lips.
The water is past your knees now.
The water is at your waist.
I swing my body around to aim at you.
My tail beats faster and faster.
Nothing in the water is faster than me.
I follow along the shallows.
My fin stays above the surface.
You run for the bank.
I reach that side first.
I circle your ankles.
The water grows shallower.
I turn on my side.
You look back at the water.
My shadow is on the bottom.
Your foot is on my back.
My teeth clamp into your calf.
I whip my head and pull you under.
I ram my snout into your ribs.
My teeth tear your skin.
You hit my snout.
Your blow knocks me back half a foot.

lines.zh: 浪头压下来，你我都看不清。
lines.en: The wave comes down and blinds us both.
I lunge again.
My fin rakes your chest.
You are dragged off balance.
My fin cuts the surface.

lines.zh: 我从河底的暗处升起来。
lines.en: I rise from the dark of the riverbed.
I circle once to get my bearing.
One more shadow joins the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我的牙在空气里空咬一下。
lines.en: My teeth snap at empty air.
My first bite is only water.
The water by the bank turns cold.
I tear through a patch of weeds.
I swim in this water.
There is an old scar on my back.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我赶紧往深处钻。
lines.en: The water heats and I dive deep.

lines.zh: 我摔在水面上，砸出一片白。
lines.en: I hit the surface in a burst of white.

lines.zh: 我本该在水里，可这次水不够。
lines.en: I belong in water, yet there is not enough of it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀起来，我被抛出去。
lines.en: The blast throws up the water and me with it.
The arrow sticks in behind my dorsal fin.
Spell-light bursts underwater.
I have not tasted meat in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the surface and I convulse.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我动不了。
lines.en: No water in the void; I cannot move.
